# Blou — Quit Smoking Tracker

> Blou is a quit-smoking tracker for iPhone. Tagline: "Quit smoking, tracked simply."
> Website: https://tryblou.com
> App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/quit-smoking-tracker-blou/id6758997298

## Product

- iOS quit tracker: streak, money saved, cravings, recovery milestones
- Free core tracking; optional premium
- Android: waitlist only (not shipped yet)
